# Titan swap component cost breakdown

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

[Partial] Calculate the total for control arms, shafts, and shocks ranging from $400 to $1500. [t261]

## Specifications

- **Bump stops (stock Titan) cost**: $220 [t261] ([Unverified] single report)
- **CV axles cost range**: $200 - $500 [t261] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Front brake lines cost**: $100 [t261] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Lower Control Arm (LCA) cost range**: $400 - $1000 [t261] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Tie rods cost range**: $60 - $100 [t261] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Titan swap shocks cost range**: $400 - $1500 [t261] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Expect a minimum total of $2,100 if sourcing parts yourself including non-OEM stock items. [t261]
- Anticipate a maximum potential cost up to $5,600 for the front end. [t261]
